policy.integration_rule: A repository listing is not an installation, adoption approval, deployment, or proof of runtime capability.

integrations.name: Rea-Video

license.expression: Apache-2.0

constraints: Use only rights-cleared reference media.
Do not upload client footage to an unapproved external service.
integrations.next_gate: Run a sandbox analysis on a rights-cleared test clip and verify output provenance.

integrations.name: Awesome Opus 5.5 Videos

license.expression: MIT for repository code; source media and prompts require individual rights review

constraints: Do not assume every referenced video or prompt grants reuse rights.
integrations.next_gate: Curate prompt metadata and source links; exclude media without reuse permission.

integrations.name: Lemo-Opuscar

license.expression: Custom project licence; commercial-use review required

constraints: Do not assume commercial reuse rights for included films, styles or assets.
integrations.next_gate: Review the complete licence and attribution terms before internal or client reuse.

integrations.name: EffectCraft

license.expression: README advertises MIT OR Apache-2.0; verify the exact licence files and release terms

constraints: Project describes itself as young and fast-moving; validate stability and interchange formats.
integrations.next_gate: Build from a pinned commit in an isolated environment and test a deterministic export.

integrations.name: PixelFX

license.expression: MIT for repository code; inspect individual asset provenance

constraints: Specialist pixel-art scope; not a general motion graphics engine.
integrations.next_gate: Test one exported sprite sheet in a client-authorised game or campaign prototype.

integrations.name: ComfyUI

license.expression: GPL-3.0; model and checkpoint licences are separate

constraints: River Ways adapter is loopback-only in the inspected code.
No live ComfyUI server or model inference is verified.
Never expose the ComfyUI API publicly.
integrations.next_gate: Capture workstation hardware, install a reviewed version and pass a low-cost local smoke test.

integrations.name: Remotion

license.expression: Proprietary/source-available licence; verify current company and automation eligibility

constraints: Do not assume OSI open-source status or free automated rendering.
integrations.next_gate: Complete licence and cost review, then benchmark against HyperFrames on the same composition.

integrations.name: Remotion Skills

license.expression: Verify repository licence and skill compatibility

constraints: Do not override River Ways root instructions, ASD-STE100 rules or approval controls.
integrations.next_gate: Review skill content and integrate only non-conflicting, source-attributed guidance.

integrations.name: HyperFrames

license.expression: Apache-2.0; review bundled dependencies and FFmpeg build

constraints: River Ways has a starter template and renderer adapter.
No real render has been verified.
integrations.next_gate: Install the pinned local CLI, run lint/check and produce a real approved internal test MP4.

integrations.name: Three.js

license.expression: MIT

constraints: Use progressive enhancement and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Measure mobile performance and bundle impact.
integrations.next_gate: Prototype one bounded scene and pass mobile performance and accessibility review.

integrations.name: GSAP

license.expression: Verify current core and plugin licence terms for selected version

constraints: Avoid overlapping animation libraries and preserve reduced-motion behaviour.
integrations.next_gate: Review licence and test a single representative interaction before adoption.

integrations.name: Blender MCP

license.expression: Verify exact repository licence and dependency licences

constraints: Audit tool schemas, subprocess execution, file access and application identity before enabling.
integrations.next_gate: Review source and run a read-only local sandbox test with synthetic assets.

integrations.name: FFmpeg

license.expression: LGPL by default; GPL-enabled build options and linked components can change obligations

constraints: No production workstation binary or exact build configuration has been verified.
integrations.next_gate: Record exact binary version, build configuration and licence notices; run media QA on a test file.

integrations.name: Adobe UXP

license.expression: Adobe developer terms and per-application API requirements apply

constraints: Application support and API availability vary by product and version.
integrations.next_gate: Inventory installed Adobe applications and select one supported application for a UXP proof.

integrations.name: adobepy

license.expression: Root LICENSE path was not found in the initial check; resolve full licence before use

constraints: Inspect platform support, release provenance, broker authentication and application-instance attestation.
integrations.next_gate: Verify licence, supported Windows versions, release signatures and tool operation allowlists.

integrations.name: Cavi Adobe MCP

license.expression: MIT

constraints: README requires macOS, Python 3.15+ and local automation access; current workstation context is Windows.
integrations.next_gate: Reconsider only if a supported macOS worker becomes available.

integrations.name: Adobe MCP Server by Jonohobs

license.expression: MIT

constraints: README claims broad Adobe app coverage; inspect each app adapter and supported version.
Review arbitrary command and filesystem exposure.
integrations.next_gate: Perform a source/security audit and read-only test against one installed Adobe application.

integrations.name: Adobe Premiere Pro UXP Samples

license.expression: Check repository and sample-level licence notices before reuse

constraints: Use sample manifests as the authority for minimum Premiere and UXP versions.
integrations.next_gate: Select one sample and verify it against the installed Premiere Pro version.

integrations.name: Postiz

license.expression: AGPL-3.0; review network-use and modified-service obligations

constraints: No service, account connection or publishing UI is verified on this branch.
Require OAuth, tenant isolation and exact-content approval.
integrations.next_gate: Reconcile the existing Postiz design branch with the Studio auth model and complete AGPL review.

integrations.name: Paperclip

license.expression: Verify upstream licence and dependency terms at selection time

constraints: Must not replace the existing execution runtime or become the permissions authority.
integrations.next_gate: Compare its current capabilities with the existing agent runtime and avoid duplicate task systems.

integrations.name: AG-UI

license.expression: Verify repository and protocol package licences at selection time

constraints: Protocol does not replace orchestration, authentication or authorisation.
integrations.next_gate: Prototype an event stream behind the existing Agent Gateway and test reconnect/replay behaviour.

integrations.name: Twenty CRM

license.expression: Verify current community and enterprise licence boundaries

constraints: Do not create a second client/contact system before deciding the CRM system of record.
integrations.next_gate: Map the current lead schema and client lifecycle before deciding whether to adopt or extend.
